risks.risk: Unclear exact model/specs (DP Compact vs another variant), which affects market price.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the torch label/model nameplate (front/back) showing the exact model/DP Compact text and any specs.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic rechargeable LED torch/light with unknown specs (worst-case: lower-spec/older unit).

risks.proof: A video/clip showing the torch fully charged, then running continuously for a timed period (e.g., 30–60 minutes) with brightness level visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not guaranteed to hold charge well (worst-case: weak battery).

risks.risk: Charging method and included accessories are unknown (charger cable/adapter, charging dock).

risks.risk: Brightness/output (lumens) and light modes are unknown.
risks.proof: A photo/video showing the torch on at each mode (if any) plus a close-up of any lumen rating on the label.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as low/unknown brightness (worst-case: basic output).

risks.risk: Condition/wear and possible damage to the casing or port is not fully assessable.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the charging port area, switch/button, and any seams/cracks; plus a photo of the torch from all sides.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the label/model nameplate showing the exact “DP Compact” model (or confirm it’s not that).
Photo/video of the torch switched ON showing brightness and any modes.
Video showing charging working (plug in → charging indicator if any → fully charged).
Timed runtime test after full charge (e.g., 30 minutes) to confirm battery health.
Photos of included accessories (charger/cable) and the exact charging port type.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a portable rechargeable LED torch/light, but the exact model (“DP Compact”) and key specs (battery health, lumens, included charger/accessories) are not readable. Without that, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
